title: A curve that lifts continuously through a map with injective derivative has its velocity in the range of the derivative
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (x₀ : Rn n) (c : ℝ → Rn n) (γ : ℝ → Rn N) (v : Rn N), DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ x₀ → Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀) → Tendsto c (𝓝 (0 : ℝ)) (𝓝 x₀) → (∀ᶠ t in 𝓝 (0 : ℝ), γ t = ψ (c t)) → HasDerivAt γ v 0 → v ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x₀).toLinearMap
